<thought>To find the appropriate retrosynthetic template, I will search the template catalog using the forward‑reaction criteria described for the Peterson reaction: a ketone and a trimethylsilyl group are broken, and a C‑C double bond is formed (with C‑O and C‑Si bonds broken, C=C formed). This should return the template ID and its SMARTS, after which I can return the mapped reaction SMILES.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C=C(C1=CC=C(OC)C=C1)C2=CC=C(OC)C=C2",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones", "trimethylsilyl"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["C-C double bonds"],
    "bonds_broken": ["C-O", "C-Si"],
    "bonds_formed": ["C=C"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
